g.text: Where does each method seriously undercount?

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each cell contains 100 texts: a value of 99 means 99 out of 100 had predicted count less than 80% of actual count.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Same color scale for both methods. Darker = more frequent undercounts. The 20% cutoff is descriptive, not a safety guarantee.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: FLORES+ dev pilot • Related translations, not 9,000 independent examples • *MiniCPM uses its HF JSON tokenizer.
